articles.title: Mars and Jupiter Are About to Meet in the Night Sky
articles.summary: Mars and Jupiter will appear side by side in the night sky on November 15-16, closer than they have been in years; look east around midnight to spot them.

articles.title: A Treasure Map Points to Earth's Missing Fossils
articles.summary: Scientists have mapped where Earth's missing fossils are most likely hiding, pointing future digs toward more recent rock layers with the greatest untapped potential.

articles.title: Why Some Brains Find Math So Hard
articles.summary: Stanford researchers found that children who struggle with math may have trouble switching problem-solving strategies, with distinct patterns of brain activity behind the difficulty.
